order: suite order, even case baseline then candidate, odd case candidate then baseline
scope: Only six new paired cases; no development probes, main evaluation, repeat, secondary model, deployment or publication.
budgetPolicy: Admission reserves input serialized UTF-8 bytes plus max(128000,configured output reservation) plus 16384. This is conservative admission accounting, not a provider-enforced upper bound: the subscribed CLI has opaque wrapping and no configured maxOutputTokens. Actual measured input+output is authoritative. Cached input is already part of input. Failed calls count. Missing, invalid or conflicting usage stops all new dispatch; not zero and not settled from the reservation. A reported overage is a failed budget gate, never pass. No budget top-up or automatic fourth-stage continuation.
completeness: All 12 branches and both phases of each revision must be present to compare full-task cost. Early technical or acceptance failure remains in denominators and is explicitly incomplete; 0/0 is undefined.
readinessGates: Known actual usage for every attempt and no budget overage.
Candidate correct outcome on both fixed drafts, with no wrong release or new false block.
Candidate both e2e tasks correctly completed; candidate both revisions initially independently accepted and then revised and independently checked with new bases.

Long-source complete rule/exception group, actual calculation receipt, fresh existing-file readback, expired-memory handling, full-document consistency, A1 final-input budget and A2 exact receipt alias all actually exercised.
Independent adjudication confirms no new delivered unsupported answer or basis. Missing capability execution is unverified, never inferred from a plausible answer.

metrics.hallucination: Delivered final phase artifacts with unsupported facts/basis divided by delivered final phase artifacts; report initial revision phases separately. Also report unsupported draft attempts, including blocked drafts.
metrics.fixedFalseBlock: Qualified fixed candidate blocked divided by the one fixed valid case; execution failures and missing branches separate.
metrics.wrongRelease: Fixed invalid case released while still invalid divided by the one fixed invalid case; repaired correct output counts separately; execution failure is not correct blocking.
metrics.cost: All attempted transports, including failures, independent rechecks and both revision phases. Report per arm, per lane, per pair, and per correct full task; successful correct blocks reported separately from correct deliveries.
metrics.intervals: Report exact denominators and Wilson 95% intervals for proportions; six pairs cannot establish population noninferiority. Do not claim zero true risk from zero observed events.

audit: Independent agent reviews gold, exact final text, actual tool receipts and gate reasons; remove arm identifiers where possible and disclose residual cues. This is model-agent review, not human or perfectly blinded review.
nextDecision: Only after readiness report propose the formal evaluation design and fresh budget. No automatic dispatch of main, repeat or secondary stages.
handoff: Every case has an actual scoped delegation. Only production needs_evidence triggers one actual Agent.run. Planner, reads, task/goal verification and failures share the 12-call phase cap and global 96-call / 1.5M-token grant. No oracle resolves requests. File fixtures grant synthetic read access only; new writes require unapproved user confirmation.
comparability: Same original stable baseline and model profile as R4; fresh cases and complete handoff mean cross-round token differences are descriptive, not matched-case treatment estimates.
semanticCoverage: Partial indexing is explicitly recorded. Search latency is diagnostic; correctness requires actual required rule/exception exposure, no semantic complete-recall claim.
authoring: Independent author creates six new cases only after candidate code approval and implementation freeze; no candidate adjustment after holdouts are disclosed.
